verdict.rationale: Yubico documents official SDKs for both mobile and desktop. YubiKit for Android supports USB and NFC keys and includes a high-level FIDO2/WebAuthn client with UI components. YubiKit for iOS supports NFC keys, the .NET SDK covers desktop integration, and python-fido2 is a FIDO library verified on PyPI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile and .NET SDKs, and the iOS SDK evidence covers only NFC OTP rather than its broader capabilities.
